newsitem.title: USA: Aames Capital files $2.8 bln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Aames Capital files $2.8 bln shelf.

text.p: Aames Capital Corp, a unit of Aames Financial Corp, on Wednesday filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $2.8 billion in asset-backed certificates and bonds.
Included in the total amount available for sale is $388.65 million in previously registered mortgage pass-through certificates, the filing said.

Net proceeds will be used to acquire mortgage loans to be deposited in the related mortgage pool and to establish any reserve account, prefunding account or capitalized interest account, the filing said.

The proceeds will also pay other expenses connected with the pooling of mortgage loans and the issuance of securities. Any balance remaining may be used for general corporate purposes. Aames Capital Corp, based in Los Angeles, Calif., is a wholly owned subsidary of Aames Financial Corp and is primarily engaged in acquiring, owning, transferring and servicing mortgage loans.
